items.label: Upgraded Sturdy Metal Construction
items.value: Our IRONCK dog crate furniture features 1.0mm thickened iron rods (upgraded from 0.8mm) and reinforced cross bars on both sides, specially designed to resist biting and damage from large, active dogs. Sturdy metal framing ensures long-lasting use—no more worries about your pup destroying their crate

items.label: Double Storage Capacity
items.value: Built-in storage shelf + hanging 4 hooks design delivers double the storage of standard dog crates, offering ample organized space for dog food, canned treats, toys, leashes and all pet essentials. Keep your dog’s living area neat and all supplies within easy reach with this functional storage solution

items.label: 2-in-1 Furniture-Style Dog Crate
items.value: This versatile dog crate doubles as a stylish coffee table/end table, seamlessly blending into your home decor. The solid, stable top supports up to 180 lbs, perfect for displaying photo frames, potted plants, decorative items or daily essentials—maximizing your home space

items.label: Safe & Comfortable Design
items.value: Crafted from high-grade wood and heavy-duty metal, this dog crate furniture ensures extreme durability and longevity. Well-ventilated structure promotes optimal airflow for your dog’s all-day comfort, while the reinforced metal door lock adds extra security, keeping even mischievous pups safely contained

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: Comes with detailed step-by-step user-friendly instructions + all necessary assembly tools—no extra tools needed! The simple, intuitive assembly process lets you set up this dog crate furniture effortlessly and quickly, so your furry friend can enjoy their cozy new space in no time
